statement: Upon the request of a governmental entity, a provider of wire or electronic communication services or a remote computing service shall take all necessary steps to preserve records and other evidence in its possession pending the issuance of a court order or other process; the records shall be retained for 90 days, extended for an additional 90-day period upon a renewed request (18 U.S.C. § 2703(f)).
caveat: A § 2703(f) preservation request is addressed to the provider and does not itself compel disclosure; production still requires the applicable § 2703 instrument. This repo does not determine the scope of a preservation duty.
